proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING CHANGE IN STOCKHOLDER VOTING
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a recapitalization plan giving all outstanding stock one vote per share, including negotiating with Class B holders to relinquish disproportionate voting rights.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING A RISK OVERSIGHT COMMITTEE
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a board report on the merits of establishing a separate Risk Oversight Committee of the board.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING SIMPLE MAJORITY VOTE
proposals.topic_summary: Requests eliminating charter and bylaw voting requirements above a simple majority, replacing them with a majority of votes cast or simple majority.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING A CONTENT GOVERNANCE REPORT
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report reviewing enforcement of content policies and assessing risks from content controversies such as election interference, hate speech and violence.
proposals.evidence: our board of directors believes that the preparation of the report contemplated by this proposal is unnecessary and not beneficial to our stockholders

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING MEDIAN PAY BY GENDER
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on policies and goals to reduce the gender pay gap, including pay gap percentages and quantitative reduction targets.
proposals.evidence: our board of directors recommends that our stockholders vote against this proposal.

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING TAX PRINCIPLES
proposals.topic_summary: Requests adopting and disclosing principles limiting offshore tax avoidance, considering impacts on local economies, government services and stakeholder reputation.
proposals.evidence: our board of directors recommends that our stockholders vote against this proposal.
